name: Helical Particle Motion
description: Simulates the helical motion of a charged particle in a uniform magnetic field subject to gravity. The particle follows a helical trajectory as it experiences the Lorentz force perpendicular to both its velocity and the magnetic field. Gravity causes a drift velocity perpendicular to both the magnetic field and the direction of gravity.

parameters.name: num_steps
parameters.description: Number of simulation timesteps to compute

outputs.name: particle_trajectory
outputs.description: 3D trajectory of the particle over time, containing position (x1, x2, x3) at each timestep
